description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipDao class, which provides data access methods for EmployeeMembership entities, including CRUD operations and search functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmployeeMembership entity, handling database operations such as save, retrieve, delete, and search with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Persists a new or updated EmployeeMembership entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership by employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeMembershipIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns existing membership IDs for a given employee among a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes specified EmployeeMembership records for an employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Searches for EmployeeMemberships based on filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for EmployeeMembership search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeMemberships matching filter criteria.
